entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, hi. I need to start a return for my VeloBand Pulse.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the device or more of a preference issue?
No, it works fine. I just changed my mind. It was an impulse buy, to be honest, and I just don't use it. Just need to return it.
Okay, I appreciate the directness. Let me just pull up your account with your phone number... one moment. Okay, I see the order here. It looks like the VeloBand Pulse was delivered on January 2nd.
Sounds right. So, can you send me the return label or not?

Sir, based on the delivery date of January 2nd, you are currently on day 17 of ownership. For the VeloBand Pulse specifically, our return policy is a strict 10-day window from the date of receipt. This is because the device activation links the hardware to a user account and for hygiene reasons.
Ten days? Are you kidding me? That's not what I thought it was. So you're saying I'm stuck with it? This is a waste of time.
I understand the policy can be surprising, and while I cannot process a return for a refund at this point, I do have a very popular solution that other customers in your exact situation use.
What is it? Just get to the point.

Of course. We have the official VeloFit Resale Marketplace. It's a dedicated platform for our community to buy and sell VeloFit gear. Since the Pulse is new and in high demand, you'd likely get a great price for it, and the process is very straightforward.
A resale site? How much work is that going to be for me?

It's designed to be quick. You create a listing, set your price, and we facilitate the secure transaction. Since it's an official VeloFit site, buyers trust it more than a random third-party platform. I can email you the direct link right now.
Fine. If that's the only option, send the link. I'll take a look.
Excellent. I've just sent that email to the address on your file. Is there anything else I can assist with?
No, that's it.
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope you have a great rest of your day.
